motions.title: Complete ChEMBL structure ingestion (6.90% -> 100%)
motions.description: The structured store holds 2,897,819 molecule rows but only 199,997 (6.90%) carry SMILES; the rest are identifiers with NULL smiles (measured in P4_INGEST_20260925.md). The ChEMBL SDF is on the WSL side (931 MB gzip) and p4_chembl_smiles_stream.py already streams it at 1,288 rec/s. Filling the remaining 2,697,822 rows gives the fabric a real chemistry substrate for drug/compound questions.
